# A demonstration profile

**This is synthetic data.** A fictional person; every figure is generated by
`make_demo_profile.py` and belongs to nobody. The profile exists so that you can see a
working product before uploading data of your own.

The demo describes **a different person**, not the author of the project: a woman of 33,
a vegetarian, an amateur runner. The main line is iron deficiency without anaemia, B12
deficiency and subclinical hypothyroidism, and separately factor V Leiden against an oral
contraceptive. A picture that coincides with anybody's real profile counts as a defect of
the demo.

What it deliberately shows, besides «everything is green»:

- **ferritin 13 against a lower bound of 20 while haemoglobin is still normal** — there is a deficiency, there is no anaemia;
- **TSH 6.42 above the range, but the action threshold of 10 is not crossed** — a reference range and a threshold for action are different objects;
- **vitamin D 23.8 does not reach the sufficiency threshold of 30** — a threshold from below;
- **TIBC with no reference range** on the form: there is no flag, but that is not the same thing as a normal result;
- **MCV 99.2 at the upper bound of 100** — macrocytosis has not set in yet, but the direction matches the fall of B12;
- **the 2025-11 panel has no albumin and no alkaline phosphatase** — biological age is not computed for it;
- **three polygenic traits are marked unreliable**, each with its reason, including the case where a direct measurement matters more than a score;
- **levothyroxine and omeprazole at the same time** — the interaction is visible from the scheme rather than from memory;
- **the n-of-1 on the evening walk finished without significance**, and the naive daily p is shown next to it — twenty times smaller and entirely false.

To run:

    SCHOLION_PROFILE_DIR=demo/profile python3 -m scholion overview
    SCHOLION_PROFILE_DIR=demo/profile python3 -m scholion serve
